item.title: First public hearing on WA's statewide proposal to tax high salaries
item.description: Washington lawmakers debated a proposal to create a statewide payroll tax on salaries above $125,000 to fund social programs.

item.title: WA's Watershed Music Festival taking a hiatus in 2026
item.description: Watershed Music Festival announced on social media it will not be happening in 2026, with the reason for canceling northwest's biggest country music and camping festival unspecified.

item.title: Seattle Mariners acquire RHP Cooper Criswell from Mets for cash considerations
item.description: The Seattle Mariners acquired right-handed pitcher Cooper Criswell from the New York Mets for cash considerations on Friday.

item.title: Sam Darnold, Charles Cross off the injury report for Seattle Seahawks ahead of NFC championship
item.description: Quarterback Sam Darnold and left tackle Charles Cross both are expected to play in Sunday's NFC championship game for the Seattle Seahawks.

item.title: Seattle Kraken can't overcome sluggish start, lose 4-2 to Ducks
item.description: Cutter Gauthier had a goal and an assist, Lukas Dostal made 21 saves and the Anaheim Ducks beat the Seattle Kraken 4-2 on Friday night for their sixth straight victory.

item.title: Seattle weather: Chilly mornings and sunny weekend ahead, highs in the 40s
item.description: It will be a chilly start to Saturday, and we can't rule out pockets of freezing fog once again for Saturday morning.

item.title: Seattle to host US Women's National Team for first time in almost a decade
item.description: National women's soccer is coming back to Seattle for the first time since 2017. After nearly a decade, the United States Women's National Team will play at Lumen Field.

item.title: Frigid weather for the start of Seattle Seahawks Sunday
item.description: We're tracking yet another frigid evening and overnight ahead of us as the city prepares for a day of tailgating and Seahawks viewing parties.

item.title: 'This looks like an execution': WA lawmakers react to MN killing by federal agents
item.description: Washington's elected leaders are reacting to the shooting of a Minneapolis ICU nurse by Border Patrol, saying it "looks like an execution" or that accountability is needed.

item.title: Former Seahawk pumps fans up as Seattle’s Pioneer Square prepares for NFC championship
item.description: Seattle businesses are preparing for the big Rams vs. Seahawks game on Sunday. We talk with a former Seahawk about setting the tone for the championships.
